title: Drunk Driver With No License Refuses To Believe She's Drunk
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On March 25th, 2023. Officers conducted a traffic stop on a drunk driver who nearly collided with another vehicle. The woman did not have a valid U.S. driver's license and believed that her French license was valid for U.S driving. She kept asking the officers what she did wrong even though she was intoxicated and couldn't pass the sobriety tests.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.

#news #police #arrest
